FLASHCARD SET · AGES 3–5

Manners flashcards — the parent shelf: 32 cards to download and print.

The whole manners deck for printing at home: thirty-two good-manners cards for ages three to five, each with its practice tip, its download button and one-tap printing — the library is the parents’ side of the class, so everything happens on this one shelf.

This is the parents’ copy of the Manners class: all thirty-two cards on one shelf, ready to print. You do not need a plan — pick the manner your days need most, download the card, and print it full size on A4 or Letter paper. Every card carries its practice tip underneath, so the how-to rides along with the picture, and the print button runs a single card through your printer with nothing else on the page. There are no card pages to hop through: the shelf is the whole set.

The shelf is yours; the lesson is your child’s. The class page at Manners teaches each manner the way a teacher would — what it means, how to model it, what to catch them doing — while this wall simply holds the deck for printing. Same cards, two jobs: the lesson lives in the class, the library is where parents print.

THE DECK · 32 MANNERS

Every card, its tip, and the buttons.

Download takes the full-size card image; Print runs just that one card through the printer. Nothing opens a new page — the shelf is the whole set.

WHERE TO NEXT

The lesson, the hall, the rest of the library.

The Manners class · The child’s lesson ↗All the extra classes ↗All flashcard sets ↗

Print a card here, teach the manner there: the Manners class is the lesson side of this deck — one card a week pinned at your child’s eye level, with the words to say and the habit to catch. Once the deck is up on the fridge, the class page is the manual that makes each card stick.
